This release has ended (2026-10-05). Its sealing key is scheduled for deletion or deleted; a vault still sealed to it can no longer be opened.

Changes

  • First test build of the vault on the staging channel: enroll, unlock, lock and recovery inside a Nitro Enclave, with each vault sealed to this release's own key.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 87187e7 (tag release/staging/1) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-04 with a matching PCR0.
